note: Declared R1 inputs. Hashes pin the exact files a review was made from. Editing a policy here is Arnav's decision only.

sig_inventory.completeness_basis: Complete cursor walk at capture time with status=any and limit=100: the first page was requested without a cursor, each later request cursor equals the previous page's nextCursor, the last page has hasMore false and nextCursor null, and 100+100+37 items give 237 unique market ids equal to the reported total. The validator re-checks all of this.
limitations: Complete only as of 2026-10-09T19:00:55Z; it does not prove the in-scope inventory today.
Market rows carry no race ID, stage ID, group ID or Info-tab resolution text; the OpenAPI Market and TournamentMarket schemas list no such fields.
Titles do not state the election cycle or whether an election is regular or special.
creator fields and the thumbnailUrl UUID segment are redacted placeholders in the committed bodies.

failures: Kalshi contains 222 state-specific contests misclassified as control

polymarket.basis: Gamma events/keyset traversal of tag_id=102289 only; tag traversal does not prove venue-wide coverage (S1-T5 README; California Governor event 57096 is a documented tag omission). The snapshot predates S1-T5-F6, so most Polymarket House party contracts are absent.

kalshi.basis: Selected election series only. The snapshot predates S1-T5-F6/C2: it has no KXHOUSERACE rows, per-district HOUSE series were admitted on ticker symbol without rules checks, there are no SENATEFL or SENATEKY rows, and the SENATELA-26 rows describe Kentucky.

limitations: Produced by an earlier fetcher revision than main; it fails the current S1-T5 validator, so its race_type labels are not used by R1.
snapshot_prices are historical observations, never live quotes; R1 ignores them.
S1-T5 admission is a reference-data identity check, not settlement equivalence with SIG.

oq_c4_related_market_groups.note: PRD OQ-C4. Group proposals in r1_mapping.json are candidates only; one contract may appear in several.

fair_value_confidence_rule.proposal_for_arnav: Proposal only, not policy: a venue outcome becomes fair-value eligible only for a verified_match with confidence high, every strict criterion same, no open discrepancy, reviewed SIG Info-tab text and a verified race identity. No numeric threshold is proposed.

race_identity_source.needed: A reviewed, authorized source that gives each SIG market's race ID (and stage ID), for example an export Arnav captures and reviews. The PRD's Oct 2 dump is not in the repository.
